recipe.visualDefinition: A retro-style 'Greetings From' postcard aesthetic featuring massive, three-dimensional block lettering that acts as windows to various scenic illustrations, set against a tropical beach background with a distressed, aged paper finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme 3D extrusion creating depth against a flat background
Contrast between fluid script and rigid block typography
Circular portrait inset overlapping the primary typographic block
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all major elements
Warm, sun-bleached color palette with high-grain texture
Long, dramatic 3D drop shadows in a contrasting warm tone

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text block occupies the central 70% of the frame, tilted slightly on a diagonal axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 3D block lettering serves as the primary anchor, supported by a circular portrait in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left script, follows the diagonal tilt of the main text down to the right, and circles back to the portrait inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with the beach background filling the periphery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sand and pale yellow for the background and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and turquoise for the ocean water.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red-orange for the 3D extrusion and internal illustration highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated tones typical of 1950s printed matter, with high value contrast in the outlines.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance
Limit to a screen-printed feel with visible halftones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Main text uses thick, geometric block forms with sharp corners
Letters must have a deep 3D extrusion extending down and to the right
Internal faces of letters must contain distinct, self-contained illustrations
Introductory script is fluid, slanted, and features high-contrast stroke widths
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to fit a perspective grid
Outlines are irregular to simulate ink bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, architectural block face and a loose, organic brush script.
graphicDevices: Circular portrait frame with thick border
Palm tree silhouette framing the top left
Sun orb in the top right

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Burbank Big Condensed or similar heavy block
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for internal illustrations.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1950s style tropical beach illustration with a palm tree on the left, a yellow sun in the top right, and a teal ocean. Apply a heavy paper grain and distressed edges. Leave the center open for large text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D block lettering in the center with a red-orange extrusion. Fill each letter with a different miniature landscape or object illustration (e.g., mountains, sailboats, fruit). Add a circular portrait frame in the lower left. Place a white brush script at the top left.

verificationChecks: Does the text contain internal illustrations?
Is there a visible 3D extrusion on the main text?
Is the overall texture grainy and aged?
Are the outlines thick and black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the portrait

mustAchieve: Cohesive color palette across disparate internal illustrations
avoid: Clean, sharp vector lines without texture

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent 3D perspective across all letters.
Ensure the grain texture is applied to the text as well as the background.
Verify that the script text is legible against the palm tree.
Confirm the circular inset has a distinct border to separate it from the main text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Postcard Aesthetic = (Large-Letter 3D Type + Internal Vignettes) * (Distressed Paper Texture + Muted Tropical Palette) + (Casual Script Overlay)
